body: CORRECTION of the N-23b proposal of 14 Nov 11:01 (the P2-12 plan, advisor accepted, 14 Nov): the server does the forgiving, once, for every client, with the SHIPPED N-23a rule (app/lib/domain/artist_typo.dart: both names 5 or more letters and one letter wrong, missing, extra or swapped with its neighbour; two from 9 letters on; never for names of 1 to 4 letters), NOT the distance table of the earlier note. ONLY symbol-for-letter look-alikes ($ @ ! 0 1 3 4 5 7) cost 0 in that measure; 'v for a' and 'k for c' are ordinary edits, so 'Corn' is NOT 'Korn' and 'LANDMVRKS' is found for 'landmarks' by the typo rule, not by a glyph table. The typed text is compared only with names the server KNOWS (the library, the identity table of P2-12 slice 3, cached catalogue names): an artist never seen and not returned by Deezer stays NOT FOUND, and one such miss goes in the N-16 set. 'Showing results for ...' never replaces the person's words and needs a drawing first (P2-12 slice 4). Still never: fuzzy matching on the phone against the catalogue, a per-keystroke search, a spelling library. This is part B of N-23 and waits for P2-12 (held by D-51 until b11) and P2-25.
